sources.title: SKT-AI/A.X-K2: SKT A.X LLM K2 - GitHub
sources.snippet: Model Summary A.X K2 is a large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model trained from scratch as a high-performance, agentic foundation model, and the successor to A.X K1. The model contains 688 billion total parameters, with 33 billion active parameters, delivering strong reasoning and instruction-following performance while maintaining practical inference efficiency.

sources.title: SK Telecom Unveils A.X K2,Driving AI Adoption in Industry and Daily ...
sources.snippet: Going forward, SKT plans to scale the successor to A.X K2 to the trillion-parameter range to secure global competitiveness. The company has been expanding its parameter scale to match that of leading global players, and introduced 500B-plus large-scale models in the first phase of the Sovereign AI Foundation Model Project.
